review_candidates.title: AI Project/Program Manager
review_candidates.description: Hello, We are hiring for AI Project/Program Manager Role: AI Project/Program Manager Location: Remote Language: Arabic Speaker Job Description: AI Project Program Manager We are seeking an experienced Project Manager, where you will serve as the critical bridge between what was sold and what is realized for our customers. In this high-impact role, you will orchestrate end-to-end deployment projects - including large-scale GPU and network rack installations -on-site within customer data center environments, ensuring every solution lands on time, on budget, and fully aligned to contracted outcomes. You will operate at the intersection of hands-on delivery excellence and strategic advisory, leveraging predictive risk insights and an AI-forward mindset to drive measurable customer value. What You'll Achieve You will evolve beyond traditional project management into the role of a trusted value orchestrator -someone who doesn't just track milestones but actively shapes customer confidence, mitigates risk before it materializes, and identifies lifecycle value and expansion opportunities throughout every engagement. From managing daily workflows and shift-level task sequencing to resolving real-time onsite challenges, your work will ensure that the promise made during the sale becomes the reality experienced by the customer, reinforcing Dell Technologies' reputation as an outcomes-driven partner. You will: Travel regularly to customer data center sites to lead deployment activities - including GPU, network, and large-scale compute rack installations. Coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and maintaining hands-on visibility into daily workflows, shift activities, and site readiness. Serve as the customer's trusted advisor and value orchestrator, translating contracted scope into realized outcomes while acting as the primary onsite point of contact for deployment status, risk escalation, and issue resolution across logistics, installation, and construction readiness. Drive disciplined scope management by proactively identifying out-of-scope requests and facilitating formal change requests, ensuring customer approval and stakeholder accountability when scope, assumptions, or requirements evolve. Protect delivery objectives by aligning commercial, sales, and delivery teams on ownership, approvals, and remediation of scope gaps or omissions. Deploy predictive risk insights to identify early warning signals -such as schedule slippage, resource gaps, vendor delays, or site-readiness blockers, and intervene proactively to protect delivery timelines and customer confidence. Drive lifecycle value and expansion opportunities by maintaining a consultative lens throughout the engagement, providing clear daily and shift-level reporting to program leadership, and surfacing areas where additional Dell Technologies solutions can accelerate the customer's business objectives. Embrace change, emerging technologies, and AI-driven tools to continuously improve delivery methodologies, reporting accuracy, and stakeholder coordination across complex, multi-workstream data center deployments. Essential Requirements: 10–12 years of experience in project or program management within technology services, IT infrastructure deployment, or data center operations, with a proven track record of delivering complex, customer-facing deployment projects. Exceptional communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate as a credible onsite lead and advisor to technical teams, vendors, contractors, customer executives, and internal leadership simultaneously. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent deployment workstreams, balancing scope, schedule, cost, and quality, including daily task tracking, issue troubleshooting, and transparent reporting to program leadership. Desirable Requirements: Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project and related scheduling platforms. These roles will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and adjusting complex, multi-workstream deployment plans throughout the project lifecycle. A genuine enthusiasm for AI, automation, and emerging technologies, particularly experience with AI data center networking technologies and high-performance fabrics such as InfiniBand, NVIDIA NV Link, and 400G/800G Ethernet. While detailed design and implementation expertise is not required, an understanding of these technologies supports more effective installation sequencing, cross-functional coordination, risk identification, and escalation management. Strong technical acumen that enables effective engagement with architects, engineers, vendors, and deployment teams. While these roles are not expected to perform technical design or implementation work, technical fluency helps build credibility, facilitates informed decision making, and allows the PM to challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and drive discussions toward resolution rather than simply serving as an intermediary. Ability to accurately read and understand construction documents/plans. Familiarity with OSHA standards, or a willingness to obtain OSHA 30 certification. Experience operation in multi-employer, multi-vendor construction or data center environments where safety responsibilities are shared across multiple parties. Thanks, Aswini Rajesh
